label: TP
reason: The CodeQL finding correctly identifies insecure randomness via java.util.Random.nextInt() used to generate rememberMeKey (authentication token). While the XSS finding relates to harmless concatenation of session info (no user control over displayed content), the randomness issue is a real vulnerability per OWASP guidelines.

evidence.note: nextInt() call at line 65 feeds into rememberMeKey assignment at line 94
